metadata.title: Discovery of Galactic center ejected star in DESI DR1

evidence.quote: a single unambiguous HVS has been detected to date—S5-HVS1 (Koposov et al. 2020).

notes: S5-HVS1: included as a follow-up because the paper identifies it as the previously detected unambiguous HVS and explicitly reanalyzes its published parameters (T:p1-b15, T:p3-b7). DESI-312 (Gaia DR3 4226880901740499200): excluded from candidates_found because the paper’s sole selected Galactic-centre-ejecta/HVS candidate is explicitly on a bound trajectory, is currently falling back toward the GC, and ends on a radial bound orbit (T:p1-b7, T:p6-b6, T:p9-b10); its negative-energy location is also shown in I:p10-b0. HVS1 (Brown et al. 2005): only mentioned as prior background and not analyzed (T:p1-b15). WINERED-HVS1: explicitly described as a bound red giant, so it does not meet the Galactic-unbound criterion (T:p2-b3).

S5-HVS1: The supplied paper is about the new candidate DESI-312 (Gaia source ID 4226880901740499200). The target identifier S5-HVS1 occurs only as an external reference object: T:p1-b15 credits its detection to Koposov et al. (2020); T:p3-b7 reports only its metallicity ([Fe/H] = 0.29 ± 0.08 dex) and a ratio_gc obtained by re-applying this paper's methodology to parameters taken from Koposov et al. (2020); Fig. 1 (T:p3-b0, I:p3-b0) plots S5-HVS1 in orange as a reference (ratio_gc ≈ 0.8, [Fe/H] ≈ 0.3). Neither [Fe/H] nor the GC-crossing ratio is among the eligible quantities, and the paper states no position, distance, parallax, proper motion, radial velocity, galactocentric radius, rest-frame speed, or bound/unbound probability for S5-HVS1 (these are only in Koposov et al. 2020, which is not supplied). Therefore no eligible quantity can be extracted for S5-HVS1. For completeness, the star DESI-312, whose values are reported here (Table 2: RA 312.7904997 deg, Dec −1.00806508 deg, μ_α cos δ = −12.6 ± 0.0864 mas/yr, μ_δ = −13.8 ± 0.069 mas/yr, parallax 0.231 ± 0.082 mas, HRV −172 ± 0.62 km/s, D_hel 4.78 ± 0.83 kpc, V_gcr 313.94 ± 65.78 km/s), is a different object from the requested target and is not filled in.
